messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'taluscorp-prod' GPU util at 98% for 4+ mins. queue length +42, latency SLOs breached for tenant taluscorp. Autoscales blocked (no spare nodes). Paging oncall.
sara (oncall): I'm on it. Pulling metrics now.
matt (infra): I see sustained enqueue across the pool, preemptable queue piling on top. Any ongoing deployment?
dina (ml-sre): No deploys in last 30m. KV cache hit-rate dropped 12% for taluscorp — looks like a large prefix-heavy workload.
sara (oncall): Confirmed. Requests/sec for taluscorp spiked x3. Memory per worker also up ~20%. Likely long-context batching.
sara (oncall): Quick mitigation options: 1) enable burst to shared burst pool (+4 gpus) 2) throttle tenant concurrency via rate-limit 3) evict low-priority jobs for 10m. Thoughts?
matt (infra): We have 4 GPUs free in burst pool but burst requires ops approval (and will increase cost). I can toggle if SRE leads. Command is:
```
rictl pools set-burst --pool taluscorp-prod --count 4 --reason "emergency burst - high enqueue"
```
sara (oncall): Dina can we ask app team to reduce concurrency? Dina, can you DM the customer?
dina (ml-sre): Reaching out to Talus CS now, copying terry. Terry, want me to ask them to drop max_concurrency from 8->2?
terry-cs: Yes, please. I'll call the TAM and flag incident. I'll say we're activating burst as well.
lee (oncall-next): FYI, if we enable burst we should set an auto-shrink policy after 10m to avoid runaway costs.
matt (infra): Agreed. I'll prepare the command with a timer. Proposed: enable 4 GPUs then schedule scale-down in 12 minutes.
sara (oncall): Ok, let's do it. Dina/terry please push customer to throttle. Matt, enable burst and schedule shrink. I'll update incident notes and watch metrics.
matt (infra): Running now:
```
rictl pools set-burst --pool taluscorp-prod --count 4 --reason "emergency burst - enqueue spike" && rictl pools schedule-shrink --pool taluscorp-prod --delay 12m
```
matt (infra): Burst enabled. Nodes allocated: gpu-az3-{12,13,14,15}. Routing switched.
sara (oncall): Metrics: queue length dropping -10 in last 60s, p95 latency starting to fall. KV cache warming back up.
dina (ml-sre): Talus CS responded — they will drop concurrency to 2 and pause background batch jobs for 15m. They thanked us.
terry-cs: TAM on call, asked to keep us updated in 10m.
sara (oncall): Good. Setting ticket owner to sara (oncall) and postmortem owner to matt (infra). Escalation to eng-leads only if we see repeat spike after shrink.
lee (oncall-next): I'll take handoff in 15m, will monitor for regression after shrink.
sara (oncall): Handing off to @lee in 12m after scheduled shrink. Current status: mitigated, customer throttle + burst active, monitoring. Will update incident channel if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by sara (oncall).
incident-bot: NOTE: Remember to create postmortem ticket if incident > 15m CUSTOMER-IMPACT.
sara (oncall): Copy. Creating incident ticket now and tagging taluscorp-prod.
matt (infra): After action: consider adding a model-level concurrency cap or proactive autoscale cushions for high-variance tenants.
dina (ml-sre): Also recommend storing large-prefix prompts in persistent KV to avoid cold-cache storms.
sara (oncall): Closing loop: last spike cleared, queue stable, scheduled shrink in 3m. Handoff to lee.
lee (oncall-next): Taking over. I'll keep watch and file notes.
sara (oncall): Thanks all.
